_comment: The evaluation of the synthetic experiment's ensembles (specs/SPEC.md sec. 2.5 and blocks 19-22; D-126, D-127 of claude/SBI_decisions_and_ideas_log.md, project knowledge; the roadmap specs/roadmap/synth.yaml, step S6). A file of its own: the pipeline's synth.json is never touched, so the running chain is not asked to accept a change. Read by hpc/pipeline/evaluation/ev_config.py: every key is required, there are no defaults in the code, and a key starting with '_' documents the key after it and is ignored. Values marked [Claude's] are logistics, not the user's decisions.
_out_root: Absolute. samples/ (block 19), metrics/ (block 20), figures/ (block 21), calbank/ and logs/ (block 22) under it; beside the best fits (Q-E6).
_seed: The base of every seed of the evaluation (the draws, the posterior-predictive windows, the calibration draws, the bootstraps, L-C2ST); common to the ensembles (common random numbers). [Claude's]
_n_post: Posterior draws per row, n_post / M from each member (Q-E1: 1,000, 200 from each of the five members).
_batch_rows: Windows per batch through a member (memory, not results). [Claude's]
_oracle_tol: Nats: each rebuilt member must reproduce its recorded per-row NLL (on D_sim and on its search's cohort) within it, row for row, or the sampling refuses; it changes no output. 2e-3 (2026-11-12): on davinci four of the five finalists' ensembles differed by 1.2e-4 to 5.6e-4 nats, float32 roundoff of the full-size networks under another batch size and thread count than the runner's; in the sandbox a wrong member differed by 0.30 to 2.4 nats and rows misaligned by one by 9 to 11 nats. [Claude's]
_ppc_rows: D_sim's posterior-predictive rows: the first ppc_rows of its calibration rows (Q-E4: 324, a cohort's size).
_ppc_draws: Draws simulated per posterior-predictive row, spread over the members (Q-E4: 20).
_cal_glob: The calibration bank's shards (Q-E5; built by block 22's eval_calbank job under out_root/calbank).
_cal_n: The calibration bank's windows, one per theta (Q-E5: 10,000).
_cal_shards: The calibration bank's shards (cal_n divisible by them); one job each. [Claude's]
_cal_seed: The calibration bank's builder seed: distinct from the banks' seeds (sim 1000, R0 2000, R3 3000), so no nuisance draw repeats (F-aw). [Claude's]
_lc2st_null: L-C2ST's permutation trials for the null (Q-E5: 100).
_lc2st_eval_draws: Posterior draws per window at which L-C2ST's statistic is evaluated (at most n_post). [Claude's]
_bootstrap_n: Resamples of every bootstrap (the donor-cluster bands, the paired intervals). [Claude's]
_level: The level of the bands and intervals.
_formats: The figures' file formats (Q-E6: PNG and PDF).
_ncpus: Worker processes of the simulations and of the report's per-ensemble work when a command is run by hand; a job passes its own cores (jobs below). [Claude's]
_jobs: Block 22: the PBS queue and each kind of job's resources -- calbank (one job per shard of the calibration bank), sample (one per ensemble: block 19's ev_sample.py), report (one: metrics, then figures). Sized for W 18,000 windows: a bench window simulates in 0.05 s, the members' densities at 1,000 draws dominate the sampling. Block 23 added data (one: the data overview, ev_dataview.py; 4,000 + 648 windows' statistics and nine figures, a few minutes and under 2 GB in the sandbox). [Claude's]
_data_view: Block 23, the data overview (D-130): sim_shards, the simulated bank's first shards read (2 of 20: 4,000 windows of 2,000 donors, the user's); examples_per_condition, the example windows per condition of each cohort, and as many contaminated ones (D1); sim_examples, the simulated bank's example windows (D1); zoom_s, the seconds shown around a window's maximum (D1); bins, the histograms' bins (D2). [Claude's, but sim_shards]
